mission_title: Root Access Protocol: Declare System Type
briefing: Listen up, recruit! Before you even think about injecting code into the mainframe, you need to declare your intentions. Every system requires a proper handshake to identify its core architecture. Fail to declare, and your payload will be rejected.
objective: Establish the foundational system declaration for an HTML5 schematic and wrap your initial command within the core structure.
test_assertions: Verify the `<!DOCTYPE html>` declaration is present at the schematic's apex.
Confirm a single `html` element encompasses the entire operational schematic.
Ensure the `html` container correctly encapsulates a single `h1` header element.
hints: The `DOCTYPE` is your system's ID badge; make it loud and clear: `<!DOCTYPE html>`.
The `<html>` tags are your secure shell; all commands go inside.
Use `<h1>` for critical primary data display.
original_fcc_title: Declare the Doctype of an HTML Document
